content.value: The Review of System (ROS) section allows the provider to record information about the review of system option of the encounter. This feature will allow the user to retrieve or modify the Review of Systems summary. Review of Systems Templates Reference are configured in the system. The user will be able to retrieve the list of ROS templates.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Get review of systems findings and notes for given encounter
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Retrieves a Physical Exam summary for a specific encounter

inputParameters.description: If templateids are passed in, this will return only the template data for the ids passed in, and not the data selected for the current encounter. The showstructured flag must be true to use this. This can be used in conjunction with wellchildtemplateids.
inputParameters.name: templateids

inputParameters.description: If wellchildtemplateids are passed in, this will return only the template data for the ids passed in, and not the data selected for the current encounter. The showstructured flag must be true to use this. This can be used in conjunction with templateids.
inputParameters.name: wellchildtemplateids

inputParameters.description: If true, returns the review of systems as structured data. If false, returns it via lightly-HTML marked up English text, as displayed in the athenanet encounter summary.
inputParameters.name: showstructured

hpitoros.description: Whether ROS is as noted in HPI.

templates.description: The comma separated list of selected review of systems templates used.

reportedby.description: The type of person who reported information for the review of systems template. One of Patient, Parent, Caregiver, or Staff.

sectionnote.description: The structured section-level note for the review of systems section.

summarytext.description: The unstructured review of systems summary.

templatedata.description: An array of objects each containing the name and id for review of systems templates attached to the encounter.

freetext.description: The value of the text field sometimes associated with this finding.

medcinid.description: Where available, the matching MEDCIN ID for this clinical finding.

selected.description: Whether the finding is selected. If templateids are not passed in, this field will not be returned.

findingid.description: ID of the finding you are updating. If you pass in an invalid ID we will simply ignore it.

findingname.description: The label for this finding. Note that this may contain specific answers for this finding (e.g. "wakes up 2 hours after going to sleep"). See GENERICFINDINGNAME for an example that does not contain specific answers.

findingtype.description: Describes the finding -- either NORMAL, ABNORMAL, or NEUTRAL.

optionlists.description: An array of arrays.  Each inner array contains the possible options for a dropdown list. The order of the these arrays corresponds to the ordering of dropdowns from left to right within the finding.

selectedoptions.description: The options the user has chosen from any dropdowns for this finding.  The order of these selections corresponds to the order of the dropdowns from left to right in the finding name.

contradictionids.description: A string representing an array of finding IDs that contradict the current finding ID. What this means is that if this finding is selected, any findings in the CONTRADICTIONIDS should not be selected.

genericfindingname.description: The general label for this finding. It will not contain any specific answers for this finding (e.g. "wakes up ___ {{minutes*|hours}} after going to sleep").

sentenceid.description: ID of the sentence you are updating. If you pass in an invalid ID we will simply ignore it.

paragraphid.description: ID of the paragraph you are updating. If you pass in an invalid ID we will simply ignore it.

wellchildros.description:
The structured well child review of systems data. It is structured as a list of paragraphs, each containing a list of sentences, each containing a list of findings.
					This is targeted towards children but behaves the same as any other review of systems templates.

primaryEndpoints.endpointTitle: Update review of systems findings and notes for given encounter
primaryEndpoints.endpointDescription: Modifies the Physical Exam summary for a specific encounter

hpitoros.description: Whether ROS is as noted in HPI.

reportedby.description:
The type of person who reported information for the review of systems template. One of Patient, Parent, Caregiver, or Staff.
				 This will always be set to null if you do not pass any templateids even if you set this to a non null value in the API. This is because this field is only valid when there is an ROS template added to the encounter.

sectionnote.description: The text to be updated to the review of systems section note for this encounter.

templateids.description: This is a JSON array of the template ids that should remain on (or be added to) the ROS. Any template ids not included in this list will be removed from the ROS.

freetext.description: The value of the text field sometimes associated with this finding.

findingid.description: The ID of this finding. Like sentences, these are how specific findings are identified as part of the new well child ROS.

selectedoptions.description: The options the user has chosen from any dropdowns for this finding. The order of these selections should correspond to the order of the dropdowns from left to right in the finding name. Note: there must be some value specified for every dropdown in OPTIONLISTS. To indicate that no option is selected for a particular dropdown, set the corresponding value in SELECTEDOPTIONS to "" or null (e.g. SELECTEDOPTIONS: [""] or SELECTEDOPTIONS: [null]).

sentenceid.description: ID of the sentence.  These are how sentences are identified as part of the new well child ROS.

paragraphid.description: ID of a paragraph that is part of the new well child ROS.

wellchildros.description: This is a JSON structure containing everything you want the well child ROS to now contain.  If you call the GET version of this call you can see some sample output.  It is extremely important to note that anything you pass in will become the new well child ROS. Even if you only wish to make an addition, you will need to pass in the whole output of the GET plus your addition, otherwise anything you don't pass in will be removed.

freetext.description: The value of the text field sometimes associated with this finding.

findingid.description: The ID of this finding. Like sentences, these are how specific findings are identified as part of the new ROS.

selectedoptions.description: The options the user has chosen from any dropdowns for this finding. The order of these selections should correspond to the order of the dropdowns from left to right in the finding name. Note: there must be some value specified for every dropdown in OPTIONLISTS. To indicate that no option is selected for a particular dropdown, set the corresponding value in SELECTEDOPTIONS to "" or null (e.g. SELECTEDOPTIONS: [""] or SELECTEDOPTIONS: [null]).

sentenceid.description: ID of the sentence.  These are how sentences are identified as part of the new ROS.

paragraphid.description: ID of a paragraph that is part of the new ROS.

reviewofsystems.description: This is a JSON structure containing everything you want the ROS to now contain.  If you call the GET version of this call you can see some sample output.  It is extremely important to note that anything you pass in will become the new ROS. Even if you only wish to make an addition, you will need to pass in the whole output of the GET plus your addition, otherwise anything you don't pass in will be removed.

replacesectionnote.description: If true, will replace the existing section note with the new one. If false, will append to the existing note.

wellchildreportedby.description:
The type of person who reported information for the well child review of systems template. One of Patient, Parent, Caregiver, or Staff.
				 This will always be set to null if you do not pass any wellchildtemplateids even if you set this to a non null value in the API. This is because this field is only valid when there is a Well Child ROS template added to the encounter.

wellchildsectionnote.description: The text to be updated to the well child review of systems section note for this encounter.

wellchildtemplateids.description: This is a JSON array of the well child template ids that should remain on (or be added to) the ROS. Any template ids not included in this list will be removed from the well child ROS section.

wellchildreplacesectionnote.description: If true, will replace the existing well child section note with the new one. If false, will append to the existing note.

errormessage.description: If the operation failed, this will contain any error messages.

inputParameters.name: limit

ageunits.description: The units for measuring age. (Y=years, M=months, W=weeks, D=days)

encountersection.description: The section this template belongs to. For this API, either ReviewOfSystems or WellChildROS.

maxage.description: The maximum age filtered by this template

minage.description: The minimum age filtered by this template

note.description: The note attached to this template

sex.description: The sex filtered by this template
